arStrings.szText: {c_important}Rock Splitter{/c} increases your Block Chance by {c_number}[{SF_10} * 100|%+|]{/c} for {c_number}[{buffduration:SIDE_1_BUFF}]{/c} seconds and when you Block you gain {c_number}{SF_30}{/c} Vigor.
{c_important}Rock Splitter{/c} deals {c_number}[{SF_29} * 100|%x|]{/c} increased damage when hitting a Slowed or Knocked Down enemy.
Every {c_important}{SF_27}{/c} times you Block, automatically cast {c_important}Rock Splitter's{/c} {c_number}3rd{/c} attack.

{c_important}Rock Splitter{/c} increases your Thorns by {c_number}[{SF_13}]{/c} for {c_number}[{buffduration:UPGRADE_A_BUFF}]{/c} seconds and your {c_number}3rd{/c} attack deals {c_number}[{SF_15}*100|%|]{/c} of your Thorns to enemies.

{c_important}Rock Splitter's{/c} {c_number}3rd{/c} attack grants a {c_important}{u}Barrier{/u}{/c} for {c_number}[SF_31 * 100|%|]{/c} of your Maximum Life {c_number}([PlayerHealthMax() * SF_31]){/c} for {c_number}[SF_32]{/c} seconds and generates {c_important}{u}Resolve{/u}{/c}.

{c_important}Rock Splitter{/c} becomes a {c_important}Jaguar{/c} Skill that deals Fire damage. 

{c_important}Rock Splitter's{/c} {c_number}3rd{/c} attack hits twice, dealing {c_number}{payload:IMPACT_THIRD_C}{/c} damage each hit. If you have {c_number}{SF_23}{/c} stacks of {c_important}{u}Ferocity{/u}{/c}, hit an additional time.
